title: libds series backings
preamble:
# libds series backings

How libds's seven built-in series backends are shaped and registered. An
integrator supplies and registers none
([NSBK.2.3]), so the structure here is libds's own: the vtable each backend fills
in, the declaration each instance is created from, and the checks libds makes
when it registers them at engine construction.

## What this is not

- Not integrator contract. What an integrator meets of the series backends —
  which backings exist, their identities in the platform signature, the
  integrator's read — is
  [NSBK].
- Not the author-side series language — see
  [LSER].
